title: tasks-server: opt-in conditional + chat-tasks task_hidden_properties
description:
Design: docs/design/conditional.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: C9c. Crates: jmap-tasks-server, jmap-chat-tasks-server. Size: M.

Apply the C7 pattern (docs/design/conditional.md §5.1, §6, §7; conditional-02 §9.1; decision 1 in docs/design/DECISIONS.md). register_tasks_conditional; register_tasks_handlers unchanged; memory on ScopedState + ConditionalBackend; Atomic final-state checks (single default TaskList where specified, quotas/caps). In jmap-chat-tasks-server add task_hidden_properties (Task chatId hidden via ChatBackend::may_view_chat, same decision as redact_task_chat_ids) for consumers' ConditionalBackend::hidden_properties. Acceptance: precondition, atomic rollback, final-state tests; a chatId precondition for a caller who cannot view the chat -> forbidden even when the value matches; public-api additions only.
